Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle moved left
to change lanes and made contact with the side of the vehicle driven by Driver 2, which was in the adjacent lane. The
contact was a sideswipe along the left rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle and the right front area of Driver 1's
vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder following the impact and was evaluated at the scene. Driver 2
stated that the collision happened the way Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses who stpoped at the
scene gave consistent accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show damage patterns that line up with a lateral
impact of this kind, and nothing observed suggested prior damage to either vehicle. A Passenger was seated in
Driver 1's vehicle at the time and was confirmed present by both witnesses and the responding officer. Driver 1 is
listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The shoulder complaint is consistent with the forces
typiaclly associated with a sideswipe of this nature, and no further action was taken at the scene beyond exchanging
information and clearing the lanes.
